pictures.name: long_climb
pictures.scene: a stony hill track climbing steadily out of the bottom of the frame between low dry walls, its nearest stones lit warm by a late sun, the long slope above it fading into pale unbroken haze

pictures.name: weathered_trunk
pictures.scene: one old olive trunk scarred and split by long weather but still standing, its bark lit hard and warm along the bottom of the frame, the branches above it thin and dark against a bleached sky

pictures.name: rock_in_the_surf
pictures.scene: a single black rock standing firm in a heavy sea, white water breaking and streaming off its base along the bottom of the frame, the grey swell and sky beyond it flat and vast and without detail

pictures.name: long_furrows
pictures.scene: deep parallel furrows cut across heavy red earth and running far away from the bottom of the frame, the near ridges lit hard and low, the field beyond them stretching out dim and without end

pictures.name: cut_cords
pictures.scene: a thick rope lying severed on a threshing floor, its cut fibres splayed bright where a blade went through at the bottom of the frame, the swept earth beyond it opening away into warm brown shade

pictures.name: blocked_pass
pictures.scene: a high narrow pass between two shoulders of dark rock with the way through it blocked by fallen stone, the rubble lit low and cold, the cliffs above closing the gap against a colourless sky

pictures.name: grass_on_the_roof
pictures.scene: a thin scatter of pale withered grass rooted in the dust of a flat mud roof, the dry blades lit hard and low at the bottom of the frame, the empty roof beyond them running away into flat shadow

pictures.name: empty_binding_cord
pictures.scene: a loose coil of binding cord lying alone on bare stubble with nothing gathered into it, the cord lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the cut field beyond it empty out to a dull horizon

pictures.name: gate_with_nobody_on_the_track
pictures.scene: a field gate standing open on an empty harvest track, the gatepost lit warm and low at the bottom of the frame, the track beyond it going quietly away into a still grey evening with nobody on it

lines.text: Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth—
many a time they have persecuted me from my youth,
but they have not prevailed against me.
The plowmen plowed over my back;
He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
May they be like grass on the rooftops,
which withers before it can grow,
unable to fill the hands of the reaper,
or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
May none who pass by say to them,
“The blessing of the LORD be on you;
we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
